message.content: Sure! To figure out who has the most hearts, I’ll need to know how many people are playing and how many cards each person gets. For example, in Texas Hold’em each player receives two private cards. Let me know the details (or if you’d like me to use the standard 2‑card Texas Hold’em setup) and I’ll deal a hand and tell you who ends up with the most hearts.
